Core inflation has undershot in recent months and now stands at 2.1% in the G10 ex-US, despite energy prices surging in March. In the US, we expect core inflation closer to 3% in December 2026 given the effects of tariffs, energy prices, and AI measurement issues, with it falling closer to 2% in 2027 as those subside.
